integrity.historical_holdout_status: CONSUMED; no date in historical storage may be presented as fresh validation
integrity.development_period: 2001-01-01 to 2024-12-31 (full history; characterization exercise, not a holdout test)
integrity.forward_validation: Prospective paper track if the falsification criteria are met. Do not build a composite or paper track and do not consume holdout data as part of this program.

economic_hypothesis: On earnings announcement days, the direction of the overnight gap (open vs prior close) reflects the market's initial interpretation of the earnings news. Information-driven gaps tend to continue in the same direction intraday and over subsequent days. This is the opposite of non-earnings gaps, which reverse (Gap Fade).
mechanism: Earnings gaps are information-driven, not liquidity-driven. The gap reflects genuine repricing based on new information. Subsequent price movement continues as more market participants process and react to the same information. This is distinct from IBS/mean-reversion, which captures temporary technical dislocations.
counterparty: Initial market makers and short-term traders who fade the gap expecting mean reversion -- correct on non-earnings days but wrong on earnings days.
relationship_to_existing_engines: The IBS engine (V3.1, in paper trading) neutralizes IBS to 0.50 on earnings days and operates on the ~94% of non-earnings days. This engine operates only on the ~6% of earnings days. The two are complementary by construction with no day-level overlap.

signal_definition.sign: positive score = gapped up = BUY signal; negative score = gapped down = SELL/AVOID signal
signal_definition.is_earnings_day: 1 if the SF1 datekey (fundamentals.date, dimension='ARQ') for this ticker falls within +/-1 trading day of this trading date; SF1 datekey (filing date), not calendardate. Same underlying field (fundamentals.date, ARQ dimension) as used in IBS conditioning research.
signal_definition.event_anchor_day: If the datekey itself is not a trading session (weekend/holiday), the event is anchored to the next trading session on/after the datekey. earnings_gap is computed on that anchor trading day.

signal_direction.avoid_signal: do not hold / consider short stocks with earnings_gap < -threshold

universe.source: Sharadar domestic common stocks including delisted issues
universe.listing_policy: firstpricedate <= signal date <= lastpricedate where lastpricedate exists
universe.restriction: ONLY earnings-day events per ticker (anchor day, see event_anchor_day). This is not a daily strategy; it fires selectively (~6% of trading days per ticker).

forward_return_horizons.H1: open-to-close same day (intraday continuation); requires Alpaca intraday first-bar-at/after-09:30 ET open price; primary horizon
forward_return_horizons.note: H1 is the primary horizon because intraday continuation is the mechanism. H2-H4 measure PEAD-style persistence.

portfolio_construction.type: event-driven signal, not a traditional continuously-invested portfolio
portfolio_construction.method: For each earnings-day event, measure the return of the long bucket (gap > +threshold) and the short/avoid bucket (gap < -threshold), equal-weighted within each bucket per event day. Spread = long bucket minus short bucket.
portfolio_construction.reporting: Events per year, not portfolio NAV.

cost_model.rationale: Higher than the weekly composite cost assumption because earnings names may have wider spreads.
cost_model.note: H1 execution requires entering at the open and exiting at the close; feasible with Alpaca intraday data where covered.

factor_model.excluded: No factor regression on H1 (intraday; daily factors do not apply).

subgroup_analysis.minimum_cell_size: 20 events per bucket per sub-group; fewer than 20 is reported as INSUFFICIENT_DATA

falsification_criteria.ADVANCE: H1 long-bucket spread t > 2.0 (same-day continuation) AND H2 1-day spread t > 1.5 (persistence beyond same day) AND effect is directionally consistent across gap-size sub-groups
falsification_criteria.SECONDARY: H1 t between 1.5 and 2.0 with correct direction, OR H2 positive but t < 1.5
falsification_criteria.FALSIFIED: H1 t < 1.5 or wrong direction (if same-day continuation doesn't exist, the mechanism claim is wrong)

multiple_testing.note: Applies to claiming any single threshold as independently significant. The 2% primary threshold is the preregistered main result and is not selected post hoc; all three thresholds are reported regardless of outcome.

data_sources.sharadar: V2/data/sharadar.db -- stocks (daily OHLCV), daily (marketcap), fundamentals (dimension='ARQ', field 'date' = SF1 datekey), tickers (universe metadata)
data_sources.alpaca_intraday: V2/data/alpaca_intraday.db -- bars_15m, first bar at/after 09:30 ET, for H1 only. If a ticker/date is not covered, H1 is skipped for that event and the coverage gap is reported; no imputation or substitution of the daily open.

winsorization: All forward returns winsorized at the 1st/99th percentile before aggregation.

correlation_check.purpose: Correlation of the earnings-continuation daily return series with the V3.1 composite engine, over overlapping dates only.
correlation_check.expectation: Low correlation (near zero) because the IBS composite fires on non-earnings days and earnings continuation fires on earnings days -- complementary day-sets by construction.
correlation_check.action_if_violated: If correlation > 0.30, investigate why; the two engines may be capturing the same underlying effect.
correlation_check.caveat_recorded_in_advance: The live V3.1 paper track has inception 2026-09-09 and effectively zero historical NAV overlap with 2001-2024. If so, the correlation check will instead use the historical IBS-conditioning research daily net-return series (non-earnings-day IBS reversal, the engine underlying V3.1) as the best available historical proxy, and this substitution will be reported explicitly, not silently.

constraints: Preregistration committed before any signal computation.
is_earnings_day / event-anchor definition uses the same underlying field (fundamentals.date, dimension='ARQ') as IBS conditioning research; do not change it.
Missing Alpaca data for H1: skip that event, note coverage, do not impute or substitute the daily open.
Minimum 20 events per bucket per sub-group to report that cell; fewer than 20 is INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
Do not start building a composite or paper track until characterization is complete and reviewed.
Report all three thresholds (1%, 2%, 3%) regardless of which passes; do not selectively report only the best-looking one.
Do not read or modify any existing paper-trading state file or ledger as part of this research.
